create_ngram_synthetic_reward_builder: create an NGramSyntheticReward builder dataclass with configurable layer sizes, activations, and context size
create_ngram_convnet_synthetic_reward_bu: create an NGramConvNetSyntheticReward builder dataclass with convolutional network parameters and layer normalization options
